name: Chart story
summary: The chart that answers one question: the answer set beside it as the headline, one moment lit with a sentence, the rest of the data muted.
bestFor: The one chart on a page or a report that has to make a point: a recovery, a turning point, an outlier
avoidFor: Exploring data (use a plain line chart), or more than one point to make (use the scroll-built story)
dataShape: x + series (first is the focus) + moment: from, to, label + headline
